# Akimotoite: EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/akimotoite.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/akimotoite.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/akimotoite.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Reynard et al. (1996), BM3, ruby pressure scale

**reproduced** · `akimotoite_reynard_1996_bm3_ruby_2` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/akimotoite.md#record-akimotoite_reynard_1996_bm3_ruby_2)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

- Direct Table 1 reproduction of the ruby-pressure fit with K0 fixed at the source-adopted 212 GPa. The source says its parameter uncertainties account for pressure and volume errors, but it does not publish the exact objective or covariance. Ruby brackets are fluorescence-line-width estimates rather than stated one-sigma errors and are absent at the two ambient anchors, so the reproducible Peritheos fit uses all 16 rows, unweighted pressure residuals, and the reported one-sigma volume errors.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** akimotoite\_reynard\_1996\_table1\_compression
- **Observations:** 16
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** all rows
- **Objective:** errors\_in\_variables
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** V0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** K0

## Dorogokupets et al. (2015), 298 K generalized Rydberg-Stacey

**disagrees** · `akimotoite_dorogokupets_2015_298k_rydberg_stacey` · `RydbergStacey` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/akimotoite.md#record-akimotoite_dorogokupets_2015_298k_rydberg_stacey)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Only a partial 298 K slice of the source's joint thermoelastic objective is recoverable, and that transparent slice does not reproduce the published coefficient pair.

- The same Reynard observations have ruby and preferred ice-VII pressure assignments; Dorogokupets et al. do not identify which original coordinate they used. Both non-independent alternatives miss exact parity. The Wang P-V-T and Zhou KS tables are now complete, and an unweighted Zhou regression closely reproduces Zhou's own rounded elastic coefficients. What remains unavailable is the 2015 joint residual construction, covariance, phase-specific fixed/free mask, and the Ashida thermal inputs. Published coefficients are retained.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** dorogokupets\_2015\_akimotoite\_298k\_reconstruction
- **Observations:** 39
- **Fit kind:** partial\_298k\_rydberg\_stacey\_diagnostic
- **Selection:** recoverable 298 K literature slice
- **Objective:** unweighted pressure residuals
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; K\_infinity\_prime
